findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: siemens_developer_search, siemens_search, siemens_get_web_content · Private data: siemens_assets, siemens_search · Public sink: siemens_product_datasheet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: siemens_developer_search, siemens_search, siemens_get_web_content · Private data: siemens_assets, siemens_search · Public sink: siemens_product_datasheet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "siemens_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
